scope: Make DXF/DWG file-extension dispatch deterministic and defined for arbitrary path bytes without conflating filenames with symbol keys.

implementation.behavior: Extension dispatch folds only ASCII a-z to A-Z, preserves non-ASCII suffix bytes, and avoids passing plain possibly-negative char values to locale-sensitive ::toupper.

coverage: generated uppercase .DXF suffix selects the DXF reader and succeeds
generated UTF-8 non-ASCII suffix is rejected before either DXF or DWG reader is attempted

validation.diffCheck: git diff --check on production, test, CTest, and plan files passed

limits.worktree: uncommitted; Git metadata is read-only in this task
